name: Laeke Mariam Demessie
bio: Laeke Mariam Demessie is an Ethiopian journalist whose work spans the breadth of African affairs — from telecommunications and de-mining efforts in the Horn of Africa to biodiversity conservation and the preservation of Ethiopia's ancient Ge'ez script.
bio2: With bylines at BBC, Sudan Tribune, IPS News, and major publications, Laeke has spent decades bringing underreported stories from Ethiopia, Sudan, and the wider African continent to a global audience.
